request.query: Finnish social security coverage (Kela) and Kela card

sources.title: kela.fi
highlights: When you move to Finland, you can usually qualify for benefits from Kela and a Kela card starting from the day of the move
However, if you need a residence permit granted by the Finnish Immigration Service (migri.fi) to stay or work in Finland, you must get one before you can qualify for benefits from Kela
You must have a bank account so that we can pay your benefits to you
Personal identity codes are issued by the Digital and Population Data Services Agency (dvv.fi

sources.title: kela.fi
highlights: Also notify us of your move to Finland in the OmaKela e-service or file the form Moving to Finland or employment in Finland Y 77e (PDF) with Kela, if you have not done that already

sources.title: kela.fi
highlights: Apply for a Kela card on the form Application Kela card SV 157e (PDF). Let us also know that you are moving to Finland with the form Notification - Moving to Finland or employment in Finland Y 77e (PDF
You can apply for a Kela card either on a form or in the OmaKela e-service
Send the form together with any supporting documents to Kela, PL 10, 00056 KELA
You need a Kela card to prove that you have the right to Kela reimbursements when you go see a private doctor or a private dentist who cannot check your information electronically
